Aids to Navigation - Vancouver Harbour
Berry Point 1 light LL 410.8 has been established in Vancouver Harbour at 49 17.753N 122 59.415W.
The light is all around, obstructed from 083 to 091 degress, has a nominal range of 7.57NM
and is displaying Fl Red 4s.
